deposit(uint256).notice: Hibernate. Locked until `UNLOCK`. The new weight joins the current vote if one is set.

vote(address).notice: Point your whole weight at `target`. Any address is allowed.

withdraw().notice: Wake. Returns the full locked balance after `UNLOCK`. Weight and votes are untouched:         weight is the basket share, and votes no longer matter after waking.
